messages.author: fb92e83924bbcbf6
messages.subject: adding order to est. map()
parts:
Hello,

I have been creating genetic maps for marker data sets for which I already know the markers' physical positions. On one of my most recent maps, I have found that many of the markers on the genetic map are in the wrong order relative to what the marker order should be given the physical map. Is there a way I can input the marker order into the mapping function so that the algorithm still calculate the genetic distance and position of the markers but not change their order along the chromosomes?

Thank you very much,
Jen

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] adding order to est. map()
parts:
est.map() doesn't reorder markers, but just re-estimates the inter-marker distances, taking the marker order as given.

Only a few functions result in a change in marker positions:

movemarker
orderMarkers
switch.order

Were the markers ordered by physical position in the input file read by read.cross?

karl
